title: UOPT
body:
This mod was made in MCreator! also please do not expect this mod to be high quality, as i dont try all too hard.

This adds 1 new dimension, 1 new potion, 1 new ore, and 1 new entity (SO FAR), i will continue to make updates every few MONTHS, yes!, MONTHS because im lazy and i dont have too much creativity sometimes!

To find the 1 new entity (The vampire) you will have to look in either the pale forest, deep dark, or basalt deltas. To get the potion you must craft the Up arrow (yes, a up arrow) it is crafted using iron. To enter the new dimension you must go to the end and find some Endarium (can be found near the bottom of End Islands), using the endarium you can craft a portal to The Beginning **(1 core block surrounded by 4 frame blocks)** and right click the core block to acitvate the portal, once the portal is activated you must walk into the portal (because portal), in this new dimension you can find Heartium (how creative..) you can use heartium to craft Hearts! There is a limit to how many you can have (CAN BE EDITED WITH A GAMERULE!!). This mod doesnt offer all that much but i hope you enjoy it (if you consider downloading)
